features: Integrates Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational into the existing Scoring Tests Dashboard for both Manual and Automatic modes
Uses the shared SpecialCategoryService schedules instead of duplicating special-category point values in the Test Dashboard
Bachata Rising and Bachata Open use fixed points 5,4,3,2,1 for places 1-5; Bachata Invitational uses 3,2,1 for places 1-3
Special categories bypass participant-count point tiers while retaining the normal shared scoring calculation workflow
Special-category Heats allow the YES/callback count to be configured directly without changing the fixed points schedule
Random test competitor generation no longer recalculates Tier 1/2/3 when the round is a special category
Extends the shared special-category schema support to bdc_test_scoring_rounds and bdc_test_scoring_publications
Keeps the dev80 existing-dashboard Manual versus Automatic UI behaviour unchanged
No Staging or Production deployment performed
